findings.quote:
- run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm check
      - run: pnpm test
findings.title: CI never runs the production frontend build
findings.description: The frontend job checks types and runs tests but never invokes the existing `pnpm build` script. A change that passes `svelte-check` and Vitest while breaking Vite's production bundling or adapter output can therefore pass this new CI gate, leaving production builds unverified.

findings.title: Migration can leave credentials in plaintext config
findings.description: Project rule PROJECT_RULES.md R-14 says: "API keys, client secrets, and OAuth tokens must be stored through the secrets module or OS credential store, and must never appear in source, test fixtures, logs, error messages, or the plain config file." If this rewrite fails, the pre-keychain config file keeps its secrets and get_config ignores the failure and returns normally. Propagate the rewrite error (and ensure secret storage succeeded) so the command does not treat an incomplete migration as successful. Verified with `git show HEAD:src-tauri/src/config.rs | nl -ba | sed -n '118,150p'`; the quoted line is present.

findings.title: Config and keychain modules now depend on each other
findings.description: `config` calls into `secrets` here, while the new `secrets` module's `load_secrets`, `save_secrets`, and `sanitize_config` APIs take `super::config::AppConfig`, creating a direct module cycle. This couples the keychain adapter to the full persisted config schema and makes either side harder to change or isolate. Move the secret fields through a small secrets-owned value type or other one-way boundary so config can orchestrate persistence without secrets importing the config module.

findings.title: OAuth state validation has no regression tests
findings.description: The callback now rejects missing or mismatched OAuth state, but the existing Google Drive tests do not cover the callback validation. This is the security check that distinguishes the current authorization response from a forged callback; a regression that accepts a mismatched state or rejects a valid state would go unnoticed. Extract the callback parsing/validation into a testable helper and cover matching, missing, and mismatched state values.

findings.title: A keychain write failure is reported as a successful config save
findings.description: If the OS rejects the keychain entry or password write, this function only logs and returns; `save_config` then sanitizes the config and writes it without the credentials, while still returning success. A user saving settings during such a keychain failure loses the credentials after restart and receives no failure from the save operation.

findings.title: Webcam bubble component logic has no component test
findings.description: PROJECT_RULES.md R-16 says: "Every new public function, command, or component with logic must have a test in the same change." This new component owns the position toggle and its config persistence, but the changed tests cover only `computeWebcamBubbleRect` and blob storage; none exercises the component or toggle. Add a component test for switching positions and saving the preference. Verified with `rg -n 'WebcamBubble|togglePosition' src`; references occur in the route, component, and recorder helper tests, with no component test.

findings.title: startRecording now mixes compositor setup into a long orchestration function
findings.description: The new webcam branch adds canvas creation and resizing, hidden video setup, preview sharing, compositor startup, and captureStream fallback directly into startRecording. That function now spans about 170 lines while still handling permission acquisition and MediaRecorder setup, so changing compositor behavior requires reasoning through the full recording lifecycle and its shared cleanup state. Move the compositor setup into a focused helper that returns the selected video tracks, leaving startRecording to orchestrate capture and recorder setup.

findings.title: Webcam recording compositor has no behavioral coverage
findings.description: The added recorder tests exercise only the pure bubble-rectangle calculation; none exercises the new recording path that draws the screen and webcam into a canvas, captures its stream, or falls back when captureStream is unavailable. A regression that records a blank screen, omits the webcam, or chooses the wrong video tracks would still pass, even though compositing is the central new recording behavior. Add focused tests around the stream/compositor path, including the fallback and pause/resume cleanup behavior.
